clauses.requiredBehavior: Inspect and reuse qualified, versioned components.
clauses.prohibitedShortcut: Duplicate an owned capability for convenience.
clauses.binding: Reuse existing evidence only: hub component-lock.json, candidate manifests, docs/mvp-recovery qualification contract and records, issue #215/#193, component CI runs, qualification repo results. No new test, harness or implementation is authored or run.

clauses.requiredBehavior: Identify the controlling source, external reliance boundary, duties, expected acceptance and the authority by which a proposed change may acquire canonical standing.
clauses.prohibitedShortcut: Start against an unnamed or mutable contract.
clauses.binding: Controlling sources are exact-source bound: hub main 51c579a3 (component-lock.json blob at that commit), pinned component revisions as read from the lock, current component default-branch heads recorded as information only, GitHub state refreshed 2026-10-30. A frozen pin is never replaced by current main without explicit authority.

clauses.requiredBehavior: Distinguish implementation inspection, independent qualification, competent certification and final integration; preserve independence wherever required.
clauses.prohibitedShortcut: Fit an oracle to implementation or substitute developer tests.
clauses.binding: Assessment is kept apart from qualification and certification: the lead builder assesses read-only; Workers A-E inventory/trace separate areas; Worker F challenges the combined findings. All share one session lineage, so none is independent; no organizational independence, formal acceptance or release authority is claimed. Qualification owns verdicts.

clauses.requiredBehavior: Version, authenticate and review governance-critical policy and rule changes; protect established mandatory invariants against configuration override.
clauses.prohibitedShortcut: Treat unreviewed settings or evaluator changes as governing authority, weaken mandatory checks or introduce an unaccountable decision path.
clauses.binding: Protected invariants are untouched: no code, lock, manifest, dependency, schema, contract or frozen qualification artifact is changed; F3 is not reopened (PR #255 56a618eb, #254 01c1da1c, #253 07aa9055 frozen; Q2/Q3 UNRESOLVED; Q7 not established). Readiness findings do not confer implementation authority.

clauses.requiredBehavior: Preserve relied-upon external semantics or obtain an explicit authorized compatibility transition.
clauses.prohibitedShortcut: Introduce silent contract, rights, evidence or interface regressions through internal refactoring.
clauses.binding: External interface commitments are preserved: no interface, component pin or release gate is altered; standing holds (publication/release/production HOLD, final Tier 1 DEFERRED NOT WAIVED, Registry #58/#59, Control Plane #87, constructor tolerance, Ed25519 #26/#34, V09, DEF-OBS-TOL-OVERFLOW-1, R1) are unchanged.
